primary_query_protocol: all chronological prefixes; reset state at trajectory boundary
estimand: predict the next location from the observed prefix at a known prediction timestamp; the next POI, category and spatial region remain hidden

yjmob100k.coordinate_semantics: anonymous 500m cells; do not call them GPS coordinates

region_representation.teacher_support_confirmatory: frozen quantitative top-k regions plus __UNK_REGION__ and __OTHER__
forbidden: calling a raw POI identifier a spatial region
passing the next POI, category or spatial-region label to the LLM prompt
using any target-derived field other than the protocol-declared prediction timestamp

hard_label_source.activity_and_destination: frozen category-to-ontology map built before pilot; unseen categories map to other
hard_label_source.intent: same-poi, within-zone, return-known-poi, new-poi-known-zone, or new-zone derived causally from prefix and training target

bayesian_student.teacher_soft_count_weight: teacher confidence; invalid/fallback teacher output contributes zero teacher count
bayesian_student.distillation: expected soft counts followed by validation-selected CPT blending; the LLM output is never treated as a hard label
required_artifacts_before_pilot: representation/ontology.json with the frozen category-to-ontology contract
required_artifacts_before_confirmatory: protocol_lock.json generated from a passing pilot

teacher.role: structured mobility-belief teacher, not ground truth

inference.resampling_unit: user cluster; trajectory nested within user for all-prefix
inference.multiple_testing: Holm correction within each confirmatory family

confirmatory_comparisons: M4-adaptive-reasoning vs random-budget-matched at equal realized call rate
M5-beliefmove-full vs always-structured-llm for quality and cost

success_rules.llm_distillation: M2 improves M1 on NLL and is not worse by more than 0.005 MRR in at least two dataset families
success_rules.belief_memory: M3 improves M2 on all-prefix MRR in at least two dataset families
success_rules.adaptive_reasoning: M4 improves M3 and random-budget-matched on MRR in at least two dataset families with call rate at most 0.10
success_rules.quantitative_teacher: M5 improves M4 on NLL or MRR in at least two dataset families
success_rules.full_system: M5 improves M1 on all three dataset families, is within 0.01 absolute MRR of always-LLM, uses at most 10% of queries as LLM calls and at most 15% of always-LLM tokens/query, has p95 latency at most 25% of always-LLM, and degrades ECE by no more than 0.01

stop_rules.smoke: schema parse must be 100%, probability error below 1e-6, prompts contain no target fields, and cache resume/hash tests pass
stop_rules.pilot: valid output at least 0.95, transport error at most 0.01, teacher beats empirical prior for activity and destination, alpha is selected on one deterministic validation partition and M2 strictly improves M1 NLL on the disjoint held-out validation partition in every pilot domain, and repeated valid-output median JSD is at most 0.10
stop_rules.distillation: do not claim or expand M2 if M2 does not beat M1
stop_rules.routing: do not run a large online-LLM test if validation shows no positive realized LLM gain or router AUC is at most 0.5
stop_rules.publication: do not merge legacy Phase-2 inference-time fusion results with this protocol
